metadata.summary: Deceleration parameter crosses zero near z≈0.577.
metadata.explanation: The acceleration-onset curve shows the redshift where cosmic deceleration transitions into acceleration. PBUF predicts this transition occurs earlier than in ΛCDM because elastic expansion begins contributing before dark-energy-like behavior would normally appear. This shift is a direct signature of spacetime stiffness replacing Λ. Observational confirmation would validate PBUF's elastic-driven acceleration.
